product.preorder_bonus_text:
Purchase prior to 19 November 2026 23:59:59 to receive:

-The Vintage Vice City Pack
-One Month of GTA+

Receive a month of GTA+ with your pre-order; must be redeemed within 180 days after placing your pre-order. Subscription redemption is not available to child accounts with restrictions on age-restricted content. You will receive a pop-up notification on your console when your GTA+ subscription month is available to redeem. Open the Store, select your profile icon in the top left corner, and select “Offers & credits” to find and redeem this offer. Limited to one redemption per Platform Account.

branding.header_layout: 54px tall bar. Left: Microsoft logo (link to microsoft.com), thin vertical divider, Xbox logo (link to xbox.com home). Then primary nav: 'Game Pass' (dropdown), 'Games' (dropdown), 'Devices' (dropdown), 'Play' (link), 'More' (dropdown). Right: 'All Microsoft' (dropdown), search icon (opens an inline search box with placeholder 'Search Xbox.com'), cart icon (link to /en-US/cart, shows a numeric badge when the cart has items), account avatar circle labelled 'ME' which is the 'Sign in' control when signed out.

entry.search_results_layout: Headline 'Search results for: grand theft auto vi'. Result-type tabs across the top: 'Games (25)', 'Add-Ons (25)', 'Subscriptions (1)', 'Hardware (4)', 'Support', 'General'. Left rail: 'Sort by Relevance' dropdown and a 'Filters' list of accordions: Play with, Accessibility, Prices, Genre, Subscriptions, Age Rating, Multiplayer, Technical Features, Handheld compatibility, Supported Language. Main area: 3-column grid of tiles; each tile is a single link (aria 'Grand Theft Auto VI, $79.99') with portrait cover art, bold title, price text '$79.99+' (the '+' superscript means 'Offers in-app purchases'), and for pre-orders a full-width dark slate ribbon at the tile bottom reading 'PRE-ORDER'. Free/unpriced items show 'View game' instead of a price; sale items show original price struck through, sale price and a '-50%' badge. 'Load more' button at the bottom. Page is light theme.

steps.name: Payment (Microsoft Store checkout / purchase dialog)

fields.label: Payment method (select saved method or 'Add a new way to pay')

options: Saved payment methods on the Microsoft account (shown first)
'Add a way to pay' -> Credit or debit card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover; prepaid cards accepted)
'Add a way to pay' -> eWallet: PayPal or Venmo (sign in on the provider's site in a browser)
'Add a way to pay' -> Gift card (enter 25-character code; amount goes to Microsoft account balance and is then selectable)
Microsoft account balance (existing funds; must cover price + tax, otherwise a card is used for the remainder)
Mobile operator billing (only if already added on the account; 'not available in all regions')
Pay over time (cart notice: 'may be available for qualified customers at checkout for eligible purchases')
steps.notes: NOT observed directly (behind sign-in wall). Structure now confirmed from Xbox Support 'Making purchases on Xbox': 'Select the Buy button (the price will be displayed on the button). Verify the payment method you want to use on the Choose a way to pay or Confirm payment screen. On the confirmation screen, select Buy again to complete the purchase.' and 'Games which are available for pre-order ... you'll see the Pre-order option instead of the Buy button'. So the direct path is: PRE-ORDER -> 'Choose a way to pay' / 'Confirm payment' screen -> press 'Pre-order' again. Payment-method types confirmed from the same page ('Add a way to pay' offers Credit or debit card, eWallet (PayPal/Venmo), Gift card); the exact display order inside the picker is not verified (medium confidence). There is no shipping step for a digital-only order; the billing address on the payment method is used to calculate sales tax (Terms of Sale: 'Taxes ... will be added to the amount of your purchase and shown on the check-out page'). Promo codes are account-only and belong to the cart checkout page, not the purchase dialog.

steps.name: Review / confirm
options: Order summary: item, Subtotal, Estimated tax, Total
Cart path only: 'Add a promo code' link -> code box -> 'Apply code' (appears after 'Step 1: Shipping' and 'Step 2: Payment' are complete; account checkout only)

Terms line next to the confirm button: exact wording not verified; policy text is 'your chosen payment option is not charged until about 10 days before the game is released' (Xbox Support) and the Terms of Sale 'in force at the time you place your order ... serve as the purchase contract between us'
steps.button_label: Place order (cart checkout page) / Pre-order (direct purchase dialog, pressed a second time on the confirmation screen)
steps.notes: NOT observed directly (medium confidence). Cart path: Microsoft Support describes one checkout page with numbered sections 'Step 1: Shipping' and 'Step 2: Payment', then 'Add a promo code', then 'Follow the remaining prompts'; Xbox Support's xbox.com hardware walkthrough ends 'On the confirmation screen, select Place order to complete the purchase.' For a digital-only cart the shipping section should be absent or collapsed (inferred, not verified). Direct path: the review is the 'confirmation screen' of the purchase dialog where the 'Pre-order' button is pressed again.

payment_methods: Credit or debit card - Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover (prepaid cards accepted; 'Debit cards (not available in all regions)')
PayPal (eWallet; PayPal account needs a card or confirmed bank as funding source)
Gift card / Microsoft account balance (25-character code redeemed into the balance; balance must cover price + tax or a card takes the remainder)
Mobile operator billing (only where the carrier supports it; must already be on the account)
Pay over time ('may be available for qualified customers at checkout for eligible purchases' - provider and digital eligibility not verified)
card_fields: (Xbox Support: 'You'll be asked to provide the card number, the cardholder name, the billing address, the expiration date, and the CCV' - billing address is part of the same card form; exact label wording not observed)
checkout.charge_timing: Digital pre-order: charged immediately if paid with Microsoft account balance; card / PayPal 'around 10 days before the early access period or the release date'. If the balance is lower than the authorized amount the remainder is taken from the card and an email confirms the card payment. A failed charge is retried a few days later; if that fails the pre-order is cancelled. Pre-order can be cancelled from Order history up to 10 days before launch; after billing it becomes a refund request.
checkout.charge_policy_text: Microsoft Support: 'If you use money in your Microsoft account, we'll charge you right away. If you use any other payment option, including payment backup, we may charge you up to 10 days before the release date.' Xbox Support: 'With pre-ordered games, your chosen payment option is not charged until about 10 days before the game is released.' Terms of Sale: 'The Terms of Sale in force at the time you place your order will govern your purchase and serve as the purchase contract between us.'

account.membership_program: Xbox Game Pass (Essential $9.99/mo, Premium $14.99/mo, Ultimate $22.99/mo as of April 2026) - a subscription, not a store discount; it does not change the GTA VI price. Microsoft Rewards points can reportedly be applied to Microsoft Store purchases at checkout.

quirks: Digital only: no shipping/pickup; the cart line says 'Digital' and tax is computed from the billing address of the payment method.

Hard Microsoft-account wall: both the cart 'Checkout' button and the product page 'PRE-ORDER' button redirect the whole page to login.live.com (prompt=select_account). No guest checkout for digital games on xbox.com even though microsoft.com offers guest checkout for some physical items.
The main CTA is a direct-purchase 'PRE-ORDER' button; 'Add to cart' is hidden in the '...' overflow menu next to it, alongside 'Add to wishlist' and 'Redeem a code'.
Adding to cart gives no modal or toast; the menu item silently becomes 'Open cart' and the header cart badge updates.

Editions are separate product pages (Standard id 9p3h4968grsm, Ultimate id 9nnzsnhlr63l); the 'CHOOSE EDITION' dropdown just navigates between them. The Ultimate Edition Upgrade is also sold separately as a $20.00 add-on with its own PRE-ORDER tag.
Price strings carry a superscript '+' ('$79.99+') that footnotes '+Offers in-app purchases.'; the cart shows '†Contains in-app purchases'.

Release date mismatch: xbox.com shows 'Release date 11/18/2026' on the product page and 'Release date: 11/18/2026' in the cart, while the description says 'Purchase prior to 19 November 2026 23:59:59' and Rockstar's official date is Nov 19, 2026.
The cart is a cross-origin microsoft.com iframe embedded in xbox.com (accessibility tree does not expose it); it displays a 10-digit 'Cart:' id and a guest cart persists via cookie.

Pre-order billing: account balance is charged immediately; cards/PayPal may be charged up to 10 days before release; pre-orders can be cancelled from Order history; failed authorizations cancel the pre-order after retries.
Store pages (product, cart, sign-in) are dark theme; the search results page is light theme with a white header.
Gallery screenshots/videos show 'This content is locked' while signed out (mature/rating-pending media gate).
A 'Need help? Let's chat' Store Assistant bubble floats bottom-right on store pages.
Cart summary notes 'Pay over time options may be available for qualified customers at checkout ... when checking out with a Microsoft account.'

Two different post-sign-in UIs: the PRE-ORDER button uses the Microsoft Store purchase dialog ('Choose a way to pay' / 'Confirm payment' -> press 'Pre-order' again), while the cart 'Checkout' button uses the Microsoft Store checkout page ('Step 1: Shipping' / 'Step 2: Payment' / 'Add a promo code' / 'Place order'). Promo codes only work on the cart path.

Confirming a purchase means pressing the same button twice: Xbox Support's wording is 'On the confirmation screen, select Buy again to complete the purchase' (for pre-orders the button reads 'Pre-order').
Account balance must cover price plus tax; otherwise the remainder is charged to a card ('split the payment between a credit card and account balance').

gaps: Post-sign-in purchase dialog still not observed directly (signing in was not allowed). Its structure ('Choose a way to pay' / 'Confirm payment' screen, then press 'Pre-order' again) is now documented by Xbox Support, but whether it renders as an in-page modal or an iframe, the exact iframe URL, and the pixel layout remain unverified (medium confidence).

Order confirmation screen headline, contents and the confirmation email text were not observed; the 10-digit order-number format is inferred from the 10-digit cart id and user reports, not verified. Follow-up tried: Xbox Support pre-order FAQ and purchase-history pages (they only describe Order history, 'Completed' status and 'Details'), Microsoft Support order-history page (no format given).

Exact display order of the payment picker and whether a pay-over-time provider (Klarna/Affirm/PayPal Pay Later) appears for a digital pre-order are unverified; the set of types (card, PayPal, Venmo, gift card/balance, mobile billing) is confirmed by Xbox Support.

Exact on-screen labels of the card form are unverified; Xbox Support confirms the fields (card number, cardholder name, billing address, expiration date, CVV) and that the billing address is on the same form.
Exact charge-timing / terms-of-sale sentence shown next to the confirm button is unverified; only the policy text from Xbox Support, Microsoft Support and the Terms of Sale is recorded.

Microsoft password screen ('Sign in') and the 'Stay signed in?' interstitial were not observed because typing an email was not allowed; wording is from Microsoft's Keep-me-signed-in documentation and general knowledge (medium confidence).
Microsoft account sign-up fields not observed (the 'Create an account' dropdown was not clicked to avoid any account-creation flow); listed from general knowledge.

Cart 'Checkout' button color, search-results 'PRE-ORDER' ribbon color and sign-in page colors are estimated from screenshots (iframe/cross-origin; getComputedStyle unavailable). Product-page colors are exact from getComputedStyle.
Whether the header cart badge persists for a guest across sessions was not tested.

No YouTube walkthrough transcript of an xbox.com GTA VI checkout was found; Xbox Support links a video 'How to Pre-Order a Game on Your Xbox' that could not be transcribed here. WebSearch budget was exhausted during the follow-up, so only known URLs were fetched.
